mapper.sql: id, course_id AS courseId, title, instructions, opens_at AS opensAt, closes_at AS closesAt, time_limit_seconds AS timeLimitSeconds, attempts_allowed AS attemptsAllowed, result_visibility AS resultVisibility, state, version, created_by AS createdBy, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quiz (course_id, title, instructions, opens_at, closes_at, time_limit_seconds, attempts_allowed, result_visibility, state, version, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{courseId}, #{title}, #{instructions}, #{opensAt}, #{closesAt}, #{timeLimitSeconds}, #{attemptsAllowed}, #{resultVisibility}, #{state}, #{version}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM quiz WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND id = #{id}
SELECT FROM quiz WHERE course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY opens_at, id
SELECT FROM quiz WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND state = #{state} ORDER BY opens_at, id
mapper.update: UPDATE quiz SET title = #{title}, instructions = #{instructions}, opens_at = #{opensAt}, closes_at = #{closesAt}, time_limit_seconds = #{timeLimitSeconds}, attempts_allowed = #{attemptsAllowed}, result_visibility = #{resultVisibility}, version = #{version}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} - 1
UPDATE quiz SET state = #{state}, version = version + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id}
